Description.Name: Seamus Hallis
Description.Details: Adopted into the Hallis lineage, Seamus started out very early as an outsider. Originally serving as a tanker in the Second Armored Cavalry, his alienation was only deepened as he fell into a rare opportunity to train as a MechWarrior. After years of proving himself as a capable pilot, Seamus found himself in command of his own cavalry lance; a family of other misfit MechWarriors.
